svg.title: Project 4 of 5: Sales-Anomalies. A daily check of Lumo, the shop from Data-Generator, for unusual days in sales, margin, returns, costs and conversion in 112 segments. Each anomaly is split into causes in PLN that add up to the grosz and summed up in one sentence for the manager. Methods: Poisson forecast, z-scores, margin bridge, LMDI split, answer-key grading. Stack: Python, pandas, NumPy, DuckDB, Dash, Plotly. Animated preview: its web app (Dash) at work. A timeline of 27 anomalies in 2023-2024, then a click on the Clothing dot (15-24 July 2023) opens the note for the manager and the change of +157,553 PLN in the cost of returns split into causes that add up exactly, then back to the timeline. Link below the card: View project.
